core.name: CSS Loader
core.reason: Native Theme Store components with the Bubble Gum Rave palette applied to their supported controls.

core.name: SteamGridDB
core.reason: Gaming Mode artwork owner (requested as SteamDeckDB): covers, heroes, logos and icons for Steam/non-Steam shortcuts.

core.name: PowerTools
core.reason: Per-game/emulator tuning only; no blanket global performance profile.

recommended.name: AutoFlatpaks
recommended.reason: Flatpak update visibility from Game Mode without unattended updating.

recommended.name: Bluetooth
recommended.reason: Convenient Bluetooth controls in Game Mode.

recommended.name: Deck Settings
recommended.reason: Community performance and compatibility reports in Game Mode.

recommended.name: EmuDecky
recommended.reason: EmuDeck hotkeys, quick settings and emulator maintenance from Game Mode.

recommended.name: Game Theme Music
recommended.reason: Play theme music on game pages.

recommended.name: MagicPods
recommended.reason: Battery information and supported controls for Bluetooth earbuds.

recommended.name: TabMaster
recommended.reason: Customize Steam library tabs and filters.

optional.name: MoonDeck
optional.reason: Optional tighter Moonlight/Sunshine integration; requires MoonDeck Buddy on the host PC.

optional.name: Tailscale Control
optional.reason: QAM control for an already-installed Tailscale service.

optional.name: vibrantDeck
optional.reason: Extra saturation controls; normally unnecessary on OLED.

optional.name: Fantastic
optional.reason: Custom fan control; leave disabled unless measured testing justifies it.

optional.name: Battery Tracker
optional.reason: Track battery history and power statistics.

optional.name: Pause Games
optional.reason: Pause/resume game processes; useful for multitasking but not universally safe.

optional.name: Volume Mixer
optional.reason: Per-application volume control from Game Mode.

optional.name: BetterKeyboard
optional.reason: Optional improvements to on-screen keyboard behavior.

installation: Select desired plugins, then use `deckctl decky install-selected` to reconcile missing entries from Decky's official Store artifacts. Packages that cannot be safely resolved/validated remain missing and use the normal Decky Plugin Store fallback. No automatic removals.
